question.text: How is the final settlement price for USD-INR monthly currency futures determined?

answer.text: FBIL reference rate on the last trading day
VWAP of the last 30 minutes of trading on the expiry day
RBI reference rate on the last trading day
Average of the high and low prices on the last trading day

explanation.text: The Logic: Per the workbook (p.57), the final settlement price for INR-based currency futures (including USDINR) is the FBIL reference rate on the last trading day. The Trap: The VWAP of the last 30 minutes is the basis for the daily settlement price, not the final settlement price; p.166 highlights this contrast. Note: Do not confuse daily settlement (VWAP-based) with final settlement (FBIL reference rate on expiry).
